# Carmeo

> Free, unofficial app for Chery, Omoda and Jaecoo owners: battery, range, locks and climate, smart warm-up, trip and charging logs – on iPhone and Android.

Unofficial app – not made, affiliated with or endorsed by Chery, Chery Europe, Omoda & Jaecoo or their affiliates. Chery, Omoda, Jaecoo and model names are trademarks of their owners.

Website languages: Magyar (https://getcarmeo.app/hu/), English (https://getcarmeo.app/), Română (https://getcarmeo.app/ro/), Español (https://getcarmeo.app/es/).
Contact: support@getcarmeo.app
Telegram channel: https://t.me/getcarmeo

## Features

- [Status at a glance](https://getcarmeo.app/features/status.html): Battery, fuel and range, locks, doors and windows, tyres and where the car is parked – updated around the clock, with your own car in its real colour.
- [Remote control](https://getcarmeo.app/features/remote-control.html): Send your car a command from the sofa or the office, and see whether it really carried it out.
- [Smart warm-up](https://getcarmeo.app/features/smart-warm-up.html): Tell Carmeo when you leave. It checks the forecast and starts the climate just in time – only on the days when it is needed.
- [Trips and routes](https://getcarmeo.app/features/trips.html): No start button and no logbook to fill in. Carmeo notices each trip and keeps the distance, the electric share and the cost.
- [Charging insights](https://getcarmeo.app/features/charging.html): Live power in kW, the time left and every charge in a log – at home on the wallbox or at a public charger.
- [Alerts that matter](https://getcarmeo.app/features/alerts.html): Carmeo watches the car so you don’t have to – and you decide, phone by phone, which alerts ring, which arrive quietly and which stay off.
- [Costs and consumption](https://getcarmeo.app/features/costs.html): Enter your own fuel and electricity prices once. Carmeo turns every trip, charge and refuel into money – and shows what you saved by driving electric.
- [Tyres, service, documents](https://getcarmeo.app/features/service.html): Tyre pressures, the next service, the vignette, the MOT and the insurance – Carmeo keeps the dates and reminds you in time.
- [Security built in](https://getcarmeo.app/features/security.html): Two-step sign-in, a list of every signed-in phone, a lock on the sensitive commands – and clear rules about what Carmeo stores.

## FAQ

### Which cars work with Carmeo?

Cars that work with the official Chery app or the OMODA | JAECOO app in Europe. Tiggo 7, Tiggo 8 and Tiggo 9 are tested daily by our users.

### Why does Carmeo need my car account?

Your car only talks to the manufacturer’s online service. Carmeo uses that same service, through your own account – there is no other way to reach the car. Your password is used once to sign in and is never stored; the sign-in keys are kept encrypted.

### Will the official app keep working?

The car clouds allow one signed-in app per account. Share your car with a second account in the official app and connect that one to Carmeo – both keep working.

### Can my car account get into trouble?

Carmeo is unofficial, and the manufacturers’ terms restrict access by other apps – so they could restrict an account that uses Carmeo. That is why we recommend connecting a second account the car is shared with, not your main one. Details are in the [Terms of Use](https://getcarmeo.app/terms.html).

### What if the manufacturer changes its service?

Then a feature can stop working until Carmeo is updated. Carmeo depends on the same online services as the official app, and the manufacturers can change them at any time.

### How fresh is the data?

About every 2 minutes while driving or charging and every 10 minutes when parked. After a command Carmeo refreshes right away.

### Does Carmeo keep the car awake or drain the battery?

No. Carmeo reads what the car has already reported to the manufacturer’s online service, and asking for it does not wake the car. Commands do wake it, just as in the official app – and Carmeo can alert you if the battery drains while parked.

### Which languages and units does it support?

English, Hungarian, Romanian and Spanish. Costs in euro, forint, lei or pounds, distances in kilometres or miles, and a right-hand-drive view.

### Can my family use it too?

Yes. Invite up to five people with their own Carmeo account and decide what each may do: just look, look and use the climate, or everything. Your location is shared only if you switch it on.

### Does it cost anything?

No. Carmeo is free to use.

### How do I delete my data?

In the app: Settings → Account → Delete account – everything linked to the account is deleted at once. You can export your data first. Without the app, see [Delete your account](https://getcarmeo.app/delete-account.html).

### Who makes Carmeo?

An independent hobby developer in Budapest who drives a Tiggo 9 himself. Carmeo is not connected to the car manufacturers, and it carries no ads.
